old: Stand in the lower, stand in the farther, and you stand in the middle. The smallest one also stands; let the great pipe stand still as well.
new: Stand in the nearer, stand in the farther, and you stand in the middle. The smallest one also stands; let the great pipe stand still as well.
why: reviewer (minor): Unmatched pair: notes say nearer/farther; Hindi says lower/upper; English lower/farther.
